title: Stalks of the pushforward of a module along a closed immersion
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying continuous map is a homeomorphism of $Z$ onto a closed subset $i(Z)\subseteq X$ (for instance a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]), with stalk maps $i^\sharp_z:\mathcal O_{X,i(z)}\to\mathcal O_{Z,z}$. Let $\mathcal G$ be an $\mathcal O_Z$-module and $i_*\mathcal G$ its pushforward, $(i_*\mathcal G)(V)=\mathcal G(i^{-1}V)$ for $V\subseteq X$ open [def-pc-module-pullback]; stalks and germs are as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. (1) For every $x\in X\setminus i(Z)$ the stalk $(i_*\mathcal G)_x$ is $0$. (2) For every $z\in Z$ the map $c_z:(i_*\mathcal G)_{i(z)}\to\mathcal G_z$, $s_{i(z)}\mapsto s_z$ (for $V\ni i(z)$ open and $s\in(i_*\mathcal G)(V)=\mathcal G(i^{-1}V)$) is well defined and bijective, and it is $\mathcal O_{X,i(z)}$-linear when $\mathcal G_z$ is regarded as an $\mathcal O_{X,i(z)}$-module through $i^\sharp_z$; $c_z$ is natural in $\mathcal G$.

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 00AE (sheaves-lemma-stalks-closed-pushforward), stated there for the inclusion of a closed subset and for sheaves of sets, abelian groups or algebraic structures; the linearity over O_{X,i(z)} is the germ computation used in the proof of Modules, Lemma 08KS (modules-lemma-i-star-equivalence), literature/stacks-project/modules.tex

proof.text: Use Mathlib Scheme.Modules.pushforward for the underlying abelian presheaf of G on the scheme [def-pc-scheme]. At x outside the image, take the open complement of Set.range i.base, using h.isClosed_range. Every open contained in this complement has empty inverse image. TopCat.Sheaf.isTerminalOfEqEmpty and AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero make its section group subsingleton. Represent any two germs in that complement using exists_le_germ_eq; on the intersection their restrictions agree, so germ_res_apply identifies them.

At z, apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward.stalkPushforward_iso_of_isInducing Ab to h.isInducing. The inferred IsIso gives bijectivity by ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso. This is the cofinal-neighbourhood argument of Stacks Sheaves 00AE.

For linearity, choose a germ representative for the scalar and a representative for the module element on a smaller neighbourhood, using exists_germ_eq and exists_le_germ_eq. Restrict the scalar by germ_res_apply. Rewrite the product by PresheafOfModules.germ_smul, apply stalkPushforward_germ_apply, and identify the sectionwise pushforward action with the action through i.app. Apply germ_smul on Z and Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply. The two sides then agree definitionally.

For naturality, use stalk_hom_ext. Compose each side with a germ. Rewrite by stalkFunctor_map_germ_assoc, stalkPushforward_germ, and stalkFunctor_map_germ; the sectionwise pushforward morphism is definitionally the original morphism evaluated on the inverse-image open.

proof_origin.place: Sheaves Lemma 00AE; scalar compatibility is the germ computation of Modules Lemma 08KS, implemented with Mathlib germ_smul and germ_stalkMap_apply

lean.statement: theorem closedImmersion_pushforward_stalks {X Z : Scheme.{w}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (h : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding i.base) (G : Z.Modules) : (∀ x : X, x ∉ Set.range i.base → Subsingleton (↥(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj G).presheaf x))) ∧ (∀ z : Z, Function.Bijective (ConcreteCategory.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward Ab i.base G.presheaf z)) ∧ IsIso (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward Ab i.base G.presheaf z) ∧ ∀ (r : X.presheaf.stalk (i.base z)) (m : ↥(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj G).val.presheaf (i.base z))), ConcreteCategory.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward Ab i.base G.val.presheaf z) (r • m) = (i.stalkMap z).hom r • ConcreteCategory.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward Ab i.base G.val.presheaf z) m) ∧ (∀ H : Z.Modules, ∀ φ : G ⟶ H, ∀ z : Z, (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab (i.base z)).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map φ).mapPresheaf ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward Ab i.base H.presheaf z) = (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward Ab i.base G.presheaf z) ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab z).map φ.mapPresheaf)
